none: PAS WAW-AF9635: Six body sherds of Roman reduced ware.
contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

The six sherds are body fragments from six different vessels. Two sherds are decorated with a hand inscribed wavy lines bordered by horizontal linear grooves. Another sherd just as two horizontal linear grooves as decoration. Another shrd has rouletting as decoration. The remaining two sherds are undecorated. The type of vessel has been wheel made. The ware is a Reduced Ware, dating to the Roman…
